summary: Implemented the admin property management, review, duplicate inspection, and property-report screens using the implemented admin property and moderation contracts. The UI keeps mutations reason-bearing and server-authoritative, renders only safe property/report projections, supports Arabic RTL plus English and Simplified Chinese LTR, and is scoped to approved desktop administration routes.

verification.notes: Web source and tests passed ESLint with zero warnings.
Focused admin-property contract/view regression suite passed 8/8 tests.
Functional list, review, duplicate, report, mutation, safe-projection, and denied-refresh coverage passed 6/6 tests.
Landmark, label, keyboard focus, desktop scope, and locale direction coverage passed 3/3 tests.
Visual matrix passed 3/3 tests covering 12 ADM-14..ADM-17 locale screenshots; the existing 300-pixel native-control variance convention is applied.
Web suite passed 40 Vitest files/268 tests and 76 TAP tests. An existing unrelated MSW warning for public article-categories was emitted without a test failure.
Client and SSR web builds passed.
Contracts, API, and web root typecheck passed.
Root workspace check and lint passed.
Root configuration, API, and web test suites passed.
Contracts, API, and web root build passed.
The six consumed admin property/review/duplicate/report operations are implemented in the current runtime inventory.
